login_handoff_tasks: Tasks that take over at login
login_handoff_tasks_help: Emulators only. Enter task names, one per line or separated by commas. If the next due task is listed and outside its forbidden hours, Restart stops when account selection is ready, without entering the courtyard or collecting rewards. Leave empty for normal login. Listed tasks must switch accounts before other actions.
enable_realm_raid_chain: Run Realm Raid after each round
enable_realm_raid_chain_help: Schedule Realm Raid after every Orochi round
epoch_help: Managed automatically. Enter RESET to discard the old session and generate a new Epoch on the next run
leader_instance_help: Members select the leader from active instances; leaders may leave this empty
team_mode_help: Choose Team to run the scripted team flow with the team config; choose Solo to play with manual teammates or play alone by role
total_limit_count_help: Cumulative battle limit across team rounds, controlled by the leader; a five-times ticket still counts as 5
total_limit_time_help: Cumulative battle-time limit across team rounds, controlled by the leader
flow_shikigami_help: Open the shikigami reward page and claim the leftmost claimable reward
flow_iwanaga_help: Skip dialogue and summon animations until the Iwanagahime activity is complete
flow_summon_ten_help: Advance to the summon page and run the ten-pull until the activity is complete
flow_collection_help: Open the collection activity page; claiming is handled by the page's own buttons
flow_huanxin_gift_help: Enter the Huanxin Gift page, click Claim Reward until it disappears, then exit automatically; ends immediately if already claimed this period
flow_seimei_skin_help: Enter the Seimei Skin page and complete the WeChat share, then exit automatically; scanning the QR code must be done outside OAS
